summary: Environments can be switched to internal-only, ticketing systems connect easily, and managed tenants cost less to run.

new.title: Switch an environment to internal-only
new.text: An existing environment can now be rebuilt as internal-only while keeping all its data. It shows a plan first and only applies when told.

new.title: Ticketing system connectors (Pro)
new.text: Ready guides connect ServiceNow, Power Automate and Logic Apps to access requests. A retried request with the same ticket never creates a second one.

fixes.title: Lower cost for unchanged managed tenants
fixes.text: A managed tenant with nothing new now stops in seconds, cutting its daily running cost sharply.

fixes.title: Smaller fixes
fixes.text: Rebuilds restore the permissions of recreated identities and list leftovers to remove by hand, and the access request portal setup needs no manual step.
